title: The Soul Origin
summary: The Deputy Hall Master of the Hall of Souls, a Three-Star Dou Sheng, arrives after Xiao Yan kills the First Tianzun. He threatens Xiao Zhan, and Xiao Yan warns that he will give the Tuoshe Ancient Jade to the Gu Clan if his father is hurt. The Deputy Hall Master overpowers Xiao Yan and Yao Lao, but Zi Yan breaks into the sealed space and drives him off. Xiao Yan frees the prisoners and finds the Soul Origin at the bottom of a pool, gathered from millions of people the Hall of Souls killed. He refines it for two months, and his soul reaches the peak of the Heavenly Realm. On a soul journey he finds where the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame will appear, and Hun Miesheng, Hall Master of the Hall of Souls, attacks him there. An unknown powerhouse steps in to stop Hun Miesheng.
